## `neuro.bigInt64Array.toSorted`

Instance method on `BigInt64Array.prototype`.

> Copies and sorts the array.

## Signatures

```ts
toSorted(input: { bigInt64Array: <receiver>; compareFn?: (a: bigint; b: bigint) => number; prompt?: string }): Promise<BigInt64Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigInt64Array.prototype.toSorted` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
